Nepal PM Balendra Shah Visits India, Discusses Ties and Aid

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah arrived in India on Sunday, November 22, for a two-day state visit. He received a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan and paid tribute to Mahatma Gandhi at Raj Ghat. During his visit, Prime Minister Shah met with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. India announced a package of $1.63 billion (Rs 15,000 crore) for Nepal and the two leaders jointly flagged off the Saryu-Kamala Express, connecting Ayodhya with Janakpur Dham. Eight pacts were signed between the two nations. Shah described India as Nepal's most trusted neighbor, stating it was the first to offer help in difficult times. He also shared his vision for India-Nepal relations and invited Prime Minister Modi to visit Nepal.
